prompt:
Task packet (job-tracker, ~/Workspace/job-tracker). Promoting roles from the market board has no action contract: the only path, `promoteDecisions`, sweeps every kept role and the records it creates carry no next action. Add an explicit batch promotion in `src/market-promote.mjs`; leave `promoteDecisions` and the server route as they are.
- Export `PromotionRejected`, an error class (it may extend `ValidationError` from `src/markdown.mjs`) whose `rejected` property lists offending roles as `{ id, reason }`.
- Export `async promoteSelected({ store, dataset, decisions, selected, action, persistPromotion })`; `persistPromotion(id, recordId)` defaults to a no-op.
- The whole batch is validated before any write; any problem throws `PromotionRejected` and leaves no record. Each selected id (trimmed, deduplicated) must be on the board (`dataset.roles`), else reason `not on the board`; its `decisions[id].decision` must be `keep`: an `ignore` decision gives reason `decision is ignore, not keep`, a missing one `no keep decision recorded`. An empty selection, or a missing or unknown `action.mode`, is rejected.
- Modes: `shared` takes one `action.text` and an optional `action.due` (YYYY-MM-DD only, else rejected) for every role; a blank or non-string text is rejected with a message containing `non-empty action text`. `individual` takes `action.texts[id]` per role: a role whose entry is missing, blank or not a string goes in `rejected` with reason `no action text for this role` (checked only for roles that passed the selection checks); a shared `action.due` is rejected with a message containing `no shared due date`. `needs_scheduling` takes one non-empty `action.text` and no due date; a due date is rejected with a message containing `no due date`.
- Each created record's `nextAction` is the trimmed text and `nextStepDue` the due date, or `""` when there is none.
- After validation each role goes through the same origin-first path as `promoteDecisions` (`marketOrigin` `{ datasetSlug: dataset.meta.slug, roleId }`; an existing record for that origin is skipped and re-linked with `persistPromotion`, never rewritten). Return `{ selected: <count>, created: [{ id, recordId, title }], skipped: [{ id, title, matches: [recordId] }], failed: [{ id, title, reason }] }`; an error from `persistPromotion` after a create puts that role in `failed` with the error's message, and a retry then skips it instead of creating a second record.
Done when `node --test test/market-promote-actions.test.mjs test/market-promote-origin.test.mjs` passes. Keep existing tests' assertions as they are.

expect: (?m)^\s*(?:ok \d+ - |✔ )shared\ mode\ applies\ one\ action\ text\ and\ optional\ due\ date\ to\ every\ selected\ role(?: \(|$)
(?m)^\s*(?:ok \d+ - |✔ )individual\ mode\ carries\ each\ role's\ own\ action\ text(?: \(|$)
(?m)^\s*(?:ok \d+ - |✔ )needs_scheduling\ keeps\ the\ action\ text\ and\ omits\ the\ due\ date(?: \(|$)
(?m)^\s*(?:ok \d+ - |✔ )a\ mixed\ keep/ignore\ or\ unknown\ selection\ is\ rejected\ whole,\ before\ any\ write(?: \(|$)
(?m)^\s*(?:ok \d+ - |✔ )empty\ or\ blank\ action\ text\ is\ rejected\ without\ persisting\ a\ placeholder(?: \(|$)
(?m)^\s*(?:ok \d+ - |✔ )existing\ records\ are\ skipped\ individually\ and\ left\ untouched(?: \(|$)
(?m)^\s*(?:ok \d+ - |✔ )a\ mid\-batch\ failure\ is\ reported\ per\ role\ and\ the\ retry\ repairs\ without\ duplicating(?: \(|$)
(?m)^\s*(?:ok \d+ - |✔ )the\ action\-contract\ path\ keeps\ origin\-first\ idempotency\ across\ a\ rebuilt\ dataset(?: \(|$)

mined.subject: feat: add explicit batch-promotion action contract
